title: Let's make the worst htmx ever!
excerpt: Learning how htmx works by building one from scratch.
content_html:
This is a continuation of a series of posts about building tiny “clones” of popular web frameworks.

Web is changing rapidly, and so the tools we use to build web apps (yet, I’m sincerely happy that my React/Vue posts are now seven years old, and those frameworks are still popular and relevant).

Today the hot topic is htmx, basically a frontend library for backend developers who couldn’t care less about JavaScript. HTMX started as intercooler, then evolved and grown more features, and is there is some beauty to it:

<button hx-post="/clicked"
    hx-trigger="click"
    hx-target="#parent-div"
    hx-swap="outerHTML">
    Click Me!
</button>

In a declarative manner, it says: when the button is clicked, send a POST request to /clicked, and replace the outer HTML of the element with id #parent-div with the response data. HTMX wires together events, AJAX requests, and DOM updates hiding away frontend complexity. As long as your backend can send HTML templates you can go pretty far with it and build complete apps without a single line of JavaScript.

Method, trigger, target, swap

Looking at the example above, seems like our library should fetch() some URLs based on some triggers and update (swap) contents of some target elements. Something like this:

<button x-get="/click">Click me</button>

document.querySelectorAll('[x-get]').forEach(el => {
    el.addEventListener('click', async (e) => {
        e.preventDefault();
        const url = el.getAttribute('x-get');
        const response = await fetch(url);
        const data = await response.text();
        el.outerHTML = data;
        console.log(data);
    });
});

If our backend sends “Button clicked” in response - it should work. Open a page, click the button, buttons disappears, text is shown instead. That’s HTMX in 10 lines of code.

A few things to improve here. First, it’s nice to sanitise the response to make sure it’s HTML. Second, we should allow the user to specify a target element to swap content into. Third, we should allow the user to specify how exactly to swap the content in a target: replace, append, prepend, delete the element etc:

const attr = (el, name) => el.closest(`[${name}]`)?.getAttribute(name);

const SWAP = {
  outerHTML: (t, f) => t.replaceWith(f),
  beforebegin: (t, f) => t.before(f),
  afterbegin: (t, f) => t.prepend(f),
  beforeend: (t, f) => t.append(f),
  afterend: (t, f) => t.after(f),
  delete: t => t.remove(),
  none: () => {},
};

const swap = (mode, target, html) => {
  const tpl = document.createElement('template');
  tpl.innerHTML = html;
  (SWAP[mode] || ((t, f) => t.replaceChildren(f)))(target, tpl.content);
};

Now we can write a more generic “fetcher” function to handle different methods, triggers, targets and swap modes:

const send = async (el, method, url) => {
  const sel = attr(el, 'x-target');
  const target = sel ? document.querySelector(sel) : el;
  const mode = attr(el, 'x-swap') || 'innerHTML';
  const opts = { method: method.toUpperCase(), headers: { 'X-Request': 'true' } };
  if (el.matches('form')) opts.body = new URLSearchParams(new FormData(el));
  const res = await fetch(url, opts);
  swap(mode, target, await res.text());
};

By default we update the content of the element, unless x-target or x-swap is specified. We also follow HTMX convention and send a custom header to the backend with the request. To bind it all together we add a simple event listener than dispatches the request based on the trigger:

const METHODS = ['get', 'post', 'put', 'patch', 'delete'];

const defaultTrigger = el =>
  el.matches('form') ? 'submit' : el.matches('input,select,textarea') ? 'change' : 'click';

const scan = (root = document.body) =>
  METHODS.forEach(m =>
    root.querySelectorAll(`[x-${m}]`).forEach(el => {
      if (el.$hx) return;
      el.$hx = true;
      const evt = attr(el, 'x-trigger') || defaultTrigger(el);
      el.addEventListener(evt, e => {
        e.preventDefault();
        send(el, m, el.getAttribute(`hx-${m}`));
      });
    })
  );

scan();
// we should also call scan() after each 
// swap() inside send() at the end of it

And that’s it, in 40 lines of code we get a working HTMX clone that support all HTTP methods, custom targets and swapping strategies. A small optimisation would be avoid re-scanning the entire DOM after each swap, but instead only scan the newly added content:

new MutationObserver(ms => {
  for (const m of ms) m.addedNodes.forEach(n => { if (n.nodeType === 1) scan(n); });
}).observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });

Now it’s small and performant.

Better triggers

We can introduce a custom syntax for triggers, allowing comma-separated list of events, with optional delays, “changed” or “once” modifiers, etc:

const parseTriggers = (s) => {
  const triggers = s.split(',').map(s => s.trim());
  return triggers.map(trigger => {
    const [event, ...rest] = trigger.split(' ');
    const options = {};
    rest.forEach(opt => {
      const [key, value = true] = opt.split(':');
      options[key] = value;
    });
    return { event, options };
  });
}

This returns a list of events with options (keys/values, separated by colon in HTML attribute). Now we can write things like x-trigger="load, click one, change changed delay:500". We should also handle some events in our scan() function to handle them in a special way, i.e. load is basically setTimeout(() => send(...), 0), changed caches previous value and skips send if the value remains unchanged, once removes the event listener after the first trigger, and delay is another setTimeout with the specified delay. Your fantasy is the limit here, we could go as far as HTMX went and support viewport interaction triggers, queueing, debouncing, periodic events and much more. But we’re building a bad HTMX clone here.

Better targets

So far we use simple querySelector to find which element to swap content into. In practice, we might want to support a few more modifiers, like matching the closest ancestor or the following sibling.

const resolve = (el, sel) => {
  if (!sel) return el;
  if (sel === 'this') return el;
  if (sel === 'next') return el.nextElementSibling;
  if (sel === 'previous') return el.previousElementSibling;
  if (sel === 'document') return document;
  if (sel === 'body') return document.body;
  if (sel === 'window') return window;
  if (sel.startsWith('closest ')) return el.closest(sel.slice(8));
  if (sel.startsWith('find ')) return el.querySelector(sel.slice(5));
  return document.querySelector(sel);
};

We call it from send() instead of document.querySelector(sel) and we can now write things like x-target="closest .container" or x-target="next" to target more specific elements than a global query would target. HTMX does in fact roughly the same, if you want to inspect the code.

Better events

HTMX emits custom events like htmx:beforeRequest, allowing developers to intercept them, modify and control the request flow. We can do the same. In total we emit 4 events: beforeRequest, afterRequest, beforeSwap, afterSwap. Each event is emitted on the element that triggered the request, with full context of the current send(). Events can be cancelled by calling event.preventDefault().

Let’s also try to support server-side events, like HX-Trigger or HX-Redirect. If the server sends a HX-Trigger header, we dispatch a custom event with the contents from that header. If server sent HX-Redirect, we simply redirect the browser to that URL. I kept HX prefix here, because X-... headers is a common convention for standard HTTP headers.

const send = async (el, method, url) => {
  let target = resolve(el, attr(el, "x-target"));
  let mode = attr(el, "x-swap") || "innerHTML";
  const opts = {
    method: method.toUpperCase(),
    headers: { "HX-Request": "true" },
  };
  if (el.matches("form")) opts.body = new URLSearchParams(new FormData(el));
  if (!fire(el, "x:beforeSend", { el, url, target, mode, opts }, true))
    return;
  const response = await fetch(url, opts);
  const hdrTrigger = response.headers.get("HX-Trigger");
  if (hdrTrigger) {
    try {
      const data = JSON.parse(hdrTrigger);
      Object.entries(data).forEach(([ev, d]) => fire(document.body, ev, d));
    } catch {
      fire(document.body, hdrTrigger);
    }
  }
  if (response.headers.get("HX-Redirect")) {
    window.location.href = response.headers.get("HX-Redirect");
    return;
  }
  if (response.headers.get("HX-Refresh") === "true") {
    window.location.reload();
    return;
  }
  if (response.headers.get("HX-Retarget"))
    target = resolve(el, response.headers.get("HX-Retarget"));
  if (response.headers.get("HX-Reswap"))
    mode = response.headers.get("HX-Reswap");
  const html = await response.text();
  fire(el, "x:afterSend", { el, url, opts, target, mode, response, html });
  const detail = { el, url, target, mode, html, response };
  if (!fire(el, "x:beforeSwap", detail, true)) return;
  swap(detail.mode, detail.target, detail.html);
  fire(el, "x:afterSwap", detail);
  scan(detail.target); // rebind anything the swap just brought in
};

Our final send() got bigger, but it allows us to write plugins now but intercepting requests and swaps. Note how we propagate event details from one event to another, meaning that event handlers can modify the request and swap flow. For example, a plugin could intercept x:beforeSwap and change the target or swap mode based on some conditions or attributes.

Plugins

My initial impression from HTMX was that it does only one thing: if an event happens on some element with declarative configuration – send an AJAX request to some URL and swap the response into some other element. But if you check the reference you’ll see hx-on, hx-vals, hx-headers, hx-swap-oob, hx-params, hx-push-url, hx-history-elt, hx-sse, hx-ext and many more attributes that make it less straightforward to understand.

Can we achieve some feature parity without modifying the core “loop”? So that the “essence” of our library would be “SSS”: scan + send + swap.

For example, HTMX supports “boosting” – enhancing links and forms to use AJAX instead of full page reloads (to avoid writing x-get and x-target on each navigation link). This doesn’t even have to be a plugin, just a JS snippet:

document.addEventListener('click', e => {
  const boosted = e.target.closest('[x-boost]');
  if (!boosted) return;
  const link = e.target.closest('a');
  if (!link) return;
  const href = link.getAttribute('href');
  if (!href || href.startsWith('#') || link.getAttribute('target')) return;
  e.preventDefault();
  window.x.send(boosted, 'get', href);
});

Similarly we can “boost” forms on submit. There’s many more possible plugins to implement:

  • x-confirm — pops a native confirm() before sending, allowing user to cancel it. Needs an x:beforeSend listener, e.preventDefault() on decline.
  • x-indicator — shows a spinner while a request is in-flight. Needs x:beforeSend to toggle class/style, and x:afterSwap to undo it.
  • x-disable — disables the element for the duration of the request (avoid double-submission). Same logic as an indicator.
  • x-headers — extra request headers from a JSON attribute. Parse, merge into opts.headers in x:beforeSend.
  • x-vals / x-include — inject extra values into requests. Needs to mutate opts.body in x:beforeSend.
  • x-select — swap a fragment of the response instead of the whole HTML (keeps backend code simpler). Use querySelector the part we want, replace detail.html in x:beforeSwap to use that part.
  • x-sync — at most one request in flight: abort the old one, use the new one, or queue it. A map keyed by target.
  • x-validate — runs the browser native constraint validation before sending. All done in in x:beforeSend.
  • x-push-url / x-replace-url — updates browser history from an attribute or HX-Push-Url/HX-Replace-Url headers. Needs history.pushState/replaceState in x:afterSwap.
  • x-sse / x-ws — use streaming messages like a response and swap their content. No request/response cycle at all here, simply call x.swap() from onmessage.

None of these requires any changes to the core x.js, and each plugin is a dozen lines of code, easy to reason about and to debug. Seems like event-based plugin architecture and “SSS” API work better than I hoped (and it’s still notably smaller than htmx).

And yet, to make it fully compatible with HTMX the core needs some extra work. We need proper error handling for failed fetch(), non-2XX responses etc. This likely would need more custom events to be fired. We also likely need to expose resolve() to plugins, so that they could use the same x-target syntax everywhere. We need some promise-based cancellation, too. One obvious use case would be custom confirmation dialogs, that need to be asynchronous. View transitions likely need to be asynchronous as well, so a plugin could delay a swap until the transition is done. I’m sure there’s more things that I’m missing.

Those are left as exercises for the reader. Or you can just use htmx?

Full code of this experiment is at https://github.com/zserge/x, if you spot any bugs or willing to contribute - please do so!

I hope you’ve enjoyed this article. You can follow – and contribute to – on Github, Mastodon, Twitter or subscribe via rss.

Jul 27, 2026

See also: Let's make the worst VueJS ever! and more.

sentences.en: HTMX wires together events, AJAX requests, and DOM updates hiding away frontend complexity.
sentences.zh: HTMX 将事件、AJAX 请求和 DOM 更新连接在一起，隐藏了前端的复杂性。

sentences.en: As long as your backend can send HTML templates you can go pretty far with it and build complete apps without a single line of JavaScript.
sentences.zh: 只要您的后端可以发送 HTML 模板，您就可以使用它并构建完整的应用程序，而无需一行 JavaScript。

sentences.en: Method, trigger, target, swap

sentences.en: A few things to improve here.

sentences.en: First, it’s nice to sanitise the response to make sure it’s HTML.
sentences.zh: 首先，最好清理响应以确保它是 HTML。

sentences.en: Second, we should allow the user to specify a target element to swap content into.
sentences.zh: 其次，我们应该允许用户指定要交换内容的目标元素。

sentences.zh: 第三，我们应该允许用户指定如何准确地交换目标中的内容：替换、追加、前置、删除元素等：

sentences.en: By default we update the content of the element, unless x-target or x-swap is specified.
sentences.zh: 默认情况下，我们更新元素的内容，除非指定了 x-target 或 x-swap。

sentences.en: We also follow HTMX convention and send a custom header to the backend with the request.
sentences.zh: 我们还遵循 HTMX 约定，并将自定义标头与请求一起发送到后端。

blocks.html_en: And that’s it, in 40 lines of code we get a working HTMX clone that support all HTTP methods, custom targets and swapping strategies. A small optimisation would be avoid re-scanning the entire DOM after each swap, but instead only scan the newly added content:

sentences.en: And that’s it, in 40 lines of code we get a working HTMX clone that support all HTTP methods, custom targets and swapping strategies.
sentences.zh: 就这样，在 40 行代码中，我们得到了一个可工作的 HTMX 克隆，它支持所有 HTTP 方法、自定义目标和交换策略。

sentences.en: A small optimisation would be avoid re-scanning the entire DOM after each swap, but instead only scan the newly added content:

blocks.html_en: Now it’s small and performant.

sentences.en: Now it’s small and performant.

blocks.html_en: Better triggers

sentences.en: Better triggers
sentences.zh: 更好的触发器

blocks.html_en: We can introduce a custom syntax for triggers, allowing comma-separated list of events, with optional delays, “changed” or “once” modifiers, etc:

sentences.en: We can introduce a custom syntax for triggers, allowing comma-separated list of events, with optional delays, “changed” or “once” modifiers, etc:
sentences.zh: 我们可以为触发器引入自定义语法，允许以逗号分隔的事件列表，具有可选的延迟、“更改”或“一次”修饰符等：

blocks.html_en: This returns a list of events with options (keys/values, separated by colon in HTML attribute). Now we can write things like x-trigger="load, click one, change changed delay:500". We should also handle some events in our scan() function to handle them in a special way, i.e. load is basically setTimeout(() => send(...), 0), changed caches previous value and skips send if the value remains unchanged, once removes the event listener after the first trigger, and delay is another setTimeout with the specified delay. Your fantasy is the limit here, we could go as far as HTMX went and support viewport interaction triggers, queueing, debouncing, periodic events and much more. But we’re building a bad HTMX clone here.

sentences.en: This returns a list of events with options (keys/values, separated by colon in HTML attribute).
sentences.zh: 这将返回带有选项的事件列表（键/值，在 HTML 属性中用冒号分隔）。

sentences.en: Now we can write things like x-trigger="load, click one, change changed delay:500".
sentences.zh: 现在我们可以编写诸如 x-trigger="load, click one, changechangeddelay:500" 之类的内容。

sentences.en: We should also handle some events in our scan() function to handle them in a special way, i.e. load is basically setTimeout(() => send(...), 0), changed caches previous value and skips send if the value remains unchanged, once removes the event listener after the first trigger, and delay is another setTimeout with the specified delay.
sentences.zh: 我们还应该在 scan() 函数中处理一些事件，以特殊的方式处理它们，即 load 基本上是 setTimeout(() => send(...), 0)，changed 缓存以前的值，如果值保持不变则跳过 send，一旦在第一次触发后删除事件侦听器，delay 是具有指定延迟的另一个 setTimeout。

sentences.en: Your fantasy is the limit here, we could go as far as HTMX went and support viewport interaction triggers, queueing, debouncing, periodic events and much more.
sentences.zh: 您的幻想是极限，我们可以像 HTMX 一样支持视口交互触发器、排队、去抖动、周期性事件等等。

sentences.en: But we’re building a bad HTMX clone here.
sentences.zh: 但我们在这里构建了一个糟糕的 HTMX 克隆。

blocks.html_en: Better targets

sentences.en: Better targets
sentences.zh: 更好的目标

blocks.html_en: So far we use simple querySelector to find which element to swap content into. In practice, we might want to support a few more modifiers, like matching the closest ancestor or the following sibling.

sentences.en: So far we use simple querySelector to find which element to swap content into.
sentences.zh: 到目前为止，我们使用简单的 querySelector 来查找要将内容交换到哪个元素。

sentences.en: In practice, we might want to support a few more modifiers, like matching the closest ancestor or the following sibling.
sentences.zh: 在实践中，我们可能希望支持更多修饰符，例如匹配最近的祖先或以下兄弟。

blocks.html_en: We call it from send() instead of document.querySelector(sel) and we can now write things like x-target="closest .container" or x-target="next" to target more specific elements than a global query would target. HTMX does in fact roughly the same, if you want to inspect the code.

sentences.en: We call it from send() instead of document.querySelector(sel) and we can now write things like x-target="closest .container" or x-target="next" to target more specific elements than a global query would target.
sentences.zh: 我们从 send() 而不是 document.querySelector(sel) 调用它，现在我们可以编写 x-target="closest .container" 或 x-target="next" 之类的内容来定位比全局查询定位的更具体的元素。

sentences.en: HTMX does in fact roughly the same, if you want to inspect the code.
sentences.zh: 如果您想检查代码，HTMX 的作用实际上大致相同。

blocks.html_en: Better events

sentences.en: Better events
sentences.zh: 更好的活动

blocks.html_en: HTMX emits custom events like htmx:beforeRequest, allowing developers to intercept them, modify and control the request flow. We can do the same. In total we emit 4 events: beforeRequest, afterRequest, beforeSwap, afterSwap. Each event is emitted on the element that triggered the request, with full context of the current send(). Events can be cancelled by calling event.preventDefault().

sentences.en: HTMX emits custom events like htmx:beforeRequest, allowing developers to intercept them, modify and control the request flow.
sentences.zh: HTMX 发出像 htmx:beforeRequest 这样的自定义事件，允许开发人员拦截它们、修改和控制请求流。

sentences.en: We can do the same.
sentences.zh: 我们也可以这样做。

sentences.en: In total we emit 4 events: beforeRequest, afterRequest, beforeSwap, afterSwap.
sentences.zh: 我们总共发出 4 个事件：beforeRequest、afterRequest、beforeSwap、afterSwap。

sentences.en: Each event is emitted on the element that triggered the request, with full context of the current send().
sentences.zh: 每个事件都会在触发请求的元素上发出，并具有当前 send() 的完整上下文。

sentences.en: Events can be cancelled by calling event.preventDefault().
sentences.zh: 可以通过调用 event.preventDefault() 取消事件。

blocks.html_en: Let’s also try to support server-side events, like HX-Trigger or HX-Redirect. If the server sends a HX-Trigger header, we dispatch a custom event with the contents from that header. If server sent HX-Redirect, we simply redirect the browser to that URL. I kept HX prefix here, because X-... headers is a common convention for standard HTTP headers.

sentences.en: Let’s also try to support server-side events, like HX-Trigger or HX-Redirect.
sentences.zh: 我们还尝试支持服务器端事件，例如 HX-Trigger 或 HX-Redirect。

sentences.en: If the server sends a HX-Trigger header, we dispatch a custom event with the contents from that header.
sentences.zh: 如果服务器发送 HX-Trigger 标头，我们将使用该标头中的内容调度自定义事件。

sentences.en: If server sent HX-Redirect, we simply redirect the browser to that URL.
sentences.zh: 如果服务器发送 HX-Redirect，我们只需将浏览器重定向到该 URL。

sentences.en: I kept HX prefix here, because X-...
sentences.zh: 我在这里保留了 HX 前缀，因为 X-...

sentences.en: headers is a common convention for standard HTTP headers.
sentences.zh: headers 是标准 HTTP 标头的常见约定。

blocks.html_en: Our final send() got bigger, but it allows us to write plugins now but intercepting requests and swaps. Note how we propagate event details from one event to another, meaning that event handlers can modify the request and swap flow. For example, a plugin could intercept x:beforeSwap and change the target or swap mode based on some conditions or attributes.

sentences.en: Our final send() got bigger, but it allows us to write plugins now but intercepting requests and swaps.
sentences.zh: 我们最终的 send() 变得更大，但它允许我们现在编写插件，但拦截请求和交换。

sentences.en: Note how we propagate event details from one event to another, meaning that event handlers can modify the request and swap flow.
sentences.zh: 请注意我们如何将事件详细信息从一个事件传播到另一个事件，这意味着事件处理程序可以修改请求和交换流。

sentences.en: For example, a plugin could intercept x:beforeSwap and change the target or swap mode based on some conditions or attributes.
sentences.zh: 例如，插件可以拦截 x:beforeSwap 并根据某些条件或属性更改目标或交换模式。

blocks.html_en: Plugins

sentences.en: Plugins
sentences.zh: 插件

blocks.html_en: My initial impression from HTMX was that it does only one thing: if an event happens on some element with declarative configuration – send an AJAX request to some URL and swap the response into some other element. But if you check the reference you’ll see hx-on, hx-vals, hx-headers, hx-swap-oob, hx-params, hx-push-url, hx-history-elt, hx-sse, hx-ext and many more attributes that make it less straightforward to understand.

sentences.en: My initial impression from HTMX was that it does only one thing: if an event happens on some element with declarative configuration – send an AJAX request to some URL and swap the response into some other element.
sentences.zh: 我对 HTMX 的最初印象是它只做一件事：如果事件发生在具有声明性配置的某个元素上 – 向某个 URL 发送 AJAX 请求并将响应交换到其他某个元素。

sentences.en: But if you check the reference you’ll see hx-on, hx-vals, hx-headers, hx-swap-oob, hx-params, hx-push-url, hx-history-elt, hx-sse, hx-ext and many more attributes that make it less straightforward to understand.
sentences.zh: 但如果你检查参考资料，你会看到 hx-on、hx-vals、hx-headers、hx-swap-oob、hx-params、hx-push-url、hx-history-elt、hx-sse、hx-ext 和更多属性，这些属性使其不太容易理解。

blocks.html_en: Can we achieve some feature parity without modifying the core “loop”? So that the “essence” of our library would be “SSS”: scan + send + swap.

sentences.en: Can we achieve some feature parity without modifying the core “loop”?
sentences.zh: 我们可以在不修改核心“循环”的情况下实现一些功能对等吗？

sentences.en: So that the “essence” of our library would be “SSS”: scan + send + swap.
sentences.zh: 所以我们图书馆的“本质”就是“SSS”：扫描+发送+交换。

blocks.html_en: For example, HTMX supports “boosting” – enhancing links and forms to use AJAX instead of full page reloads (to avoid writing x-get and x-target on each navigation link). This doesn’t even have to be a plugin, just a JS snippet:

sentences.en: For example, HTMX supports “boosting” – enhancing links and forms to use AJAX instead of full page reloads (to avoid writing x-get and x-target on each navigation link).
sentences.zh: 例如，HTMX 支持“增强”——增强链接和表单以使用 AJAX 而不是整页重新加载（以避免在每个导航链接上编写 x-get 和 x-target）。

sentences.en: This doesn’t even have to be a plugin, just a JS snippet:
sentences.zh: 这甚至不必是一个插件，只是一个 JS 片段：

blocks.html_en: Similarly we can “boost” forms on submit. There’s many more possible plugins to implement:

sentences.en: Similarly we can “boost” forms on submit.
sentences.zh: 同样，我们可以在提交时“增强”表单。

sentences.en: There’s many more possible plugins to implement:
sentences.zh: 还有更多可能的插件可以实现：

blocks.html_en: • x-confirm — pops a native confirm() before sending, allowing user to cancel it. Needs an x:beforeSend listener, e.preventDefault() on decline.

sentences.en: x-confirm — pops a native confirm() before sending, allowing user to cancel it.
sentences.zh: x-confirm — 在发送之前弹出本机确认（），允许用户取消它。

sentences.en: Needs an x:beforeSend listener, e.preventDefault() on decline.
sentences.zh: 需要 x:beforeSend 监听器，e.preventDefault() 拒绝。

blocks.html_en: • x-indicator — shows a spinner while a request is in-flight. Needs x:beforeSend to toggle class/style, and x:afterSwap to undo it.

sentences.en: x-indicator — shows a spinner while a request is in-flight.
sentences.zh: x-indicator — 在请求正在进行时显示旋转器。

sentences.en: Needs x:beforeSend to toggle class/style, and x:afterSwap to undo it.
sentences.zh: 需要 x:beforeSend 来切换类/样式，并需要 x:afterSwap 来撤消它。

blocks.html_en: • x-disable — disables the element for the duration of the request (avoid double-submission). Same logic as an indicator.

sentences.en: x-disable — disables the element for the duration of the request (avoid double-submission).
sentences.zh: x-disable — 在请求期间禁用该元素（避免重复提交）。

sentences.en: Same logic as an indicator.
sentences.zh: 与指标相同的逻辑。

blocks.html_en: • x-headers — extra request headers from a JSON attribute. Parse, merge into opts.headers in x:beforeSend.

sentences.en: x-headers — extra request headers from a JSON attribute.
sentences.zh: x-headers — 来自 JSON 属性的额外请求标头。

sentences.en: Parse, merge into opts.headers in x:beforeSend.
sentences.zh: 解析、合并到 x:beforeSend 中的 opts.headers 中。

blocks.html_en: • x-vals / x-include — inject extra values into requests. Needs to mutate opts.body in x:beforeSend.

sentences.en: x-vals / x-include — inject extra values into requests.
sentences.zh: x-vals / x-include — 在请求中注入额外的值。

sentences.en: Needs to mutate opts.body in x:beforeSend.
sentences.zh: 需要在 x:beforeSend 中改变 opts.body。

blocks.html_en: • x-select — swap a fragment of the response instead of the whole HTML (keeps backend code simpler). Use querySelector the part we want, replace detail.html in x:beforeSwap to use that part.

sentences.en: x-select — swap a fragment of the response instead of the whole HTML (keeps backend code simpler).
sentences.zh: x-select — 交换响应的片段而不是整个 HTML（使后端代码更简单）。

sentences.en: Use querySelector the part we want, replace detail.html in x:beforeSwap to use that part.
sentences.zh: 使用querySelector我们想要的部分，替换x:beforeSwap中的detail.html以使用该部分。

blocks.html_en: • x-sync — at most one request in flight: abort the old one, use the new one, or queue it. A map keyed by target.

sentences.en: x-sync — at most one request in flight: abort the old one, use the new one, or queue it.
sentences.zh: x-sync — 最多有一个正在运行的请求：中止旧请求、使用新请求或将其排队。

sentences.en: A map keyed by target.
sentences.zh: 由目标键入的地图。

blocks.html_en: • x-validate — runs the browser native constraint validation before sending. All done in in x:beforeSend.

sentences.en: x-validate — runs the browser native constraint validation before sending.
sentences.zh: x-validate — 在发送之前运行浏览器本机约束验证。

sentences.en: All done in in x:beforeSend.
sentences.zh: 一切都在 x:beforeSend 中完成。

blocks.html_en: • x-push-url / x-replace-url — updates browser history from an attribute or HX-Push-Url/HX-Replace-Url headers. Needs history.pushState/replaceState in x:afterSwap.

sentences.en: x-push-url / x-replace-url — updates browser history from an attribute or HX-Push-Url/HX-Replace-Url headers.
sentences.zh: x-push-url / x-replace-url — 从属性或 HX-Push-Url/HX-Replace-Url 标头更新浏览器历史记录。

sentences.en: Needs history.pushState/replaceState in x:afterSwap.
sentences.zh: 需要 x:afterSwap 中的history.pushState/replaceState。

blocks.html_en: • x-sse / x-ws — use streaming messages like a response and swap their content. No request/response cycle at all here, simply call x.swap() from onmessage.

sentences.en: x-sse / x-ws — use streaming messages like a response and swap their content.
sentences.zh: x-sse / x-ws — 使用流消息作为响应并交换其内容。

sentences.en: No request/response cycle at all here, simply call x.swap() from onmessage.
sentences.zh: 这里根本没有请求/响应循环，只需从 onmessage 调用 x.swap() 即可。

blocks.html_en: None of these requires any changes to the core x.js, and each plugin is a dozen lines of code, easy to reason about and to debug. Seems like event-based plugin architecture and “SSS” API work better than I hoped (and it’s still notably smaller than htmx).

sentences.en: None of these requires any changes to the core x.js, and each plugin is a dozen lines of code, easy to reason about and to debug.
sentences.zh: 这些都不需要对核心 x.js 进行任何更改，每个插件都是十几行代码，易于推理和调试。

sentences.en: Seems like event-based plugin architecture and “SSS” API work better than I hoped (and it’s still notably smaller than htmx).
sentences.zh: 看起来基于事件的插件架构和“SSS”API 的工作效果比我希望的要好（而且它仍然比 htmx 小）。

blocks.html_en: And yet, to make it fully compatible with HTMX the core needs some extra work. We need proper error handling for failed fetch(), non-2XX responses etc. This likely would need more custom events to be fired. We also likely need to expose resolve() to plugins, so that they could use the same x-target syntax everywhere. We need some promise-based cancellation, too. One obvious use case would be custom confirmation dialogs, that need to be asynchronous. View transitions likely need to be asynchronous as well, so a plugin could delay a swap until the transition is done. I’m sure there’s more things that I’m missing.

sentences.en: And yet, to make it fully compatible with HTMX the core needs some extra work.
sentences.zh: 然而，为了使其与 HTMX 完全兼容，核心需要一些额外的工作。

sentences.en: We need proper error handling for failed fetch(), non-2XX responses etc. This likely would need more custom events to be fired.
sentences.zh: 我们需要对失败的 fetch()、非 2XX 响应等进行适当的错误处理。这可能需要触发更多自定义事件。

sentences.en: We also likely need to expose resolve() to plugins, so that they could use the same x-target syntax everywhere.
sentences.zh: 我们还可能需要将resolve()暴露给插件，以便它们可以在任何地方使用相同的x-target语法。

sentences.en: We need some promise-based cancellation, too.
sentences.zh: 我们还需要一些基于承诺的取消。

sentences.en: One obvious use case would be custom confirmation dialogs, that need to be asynchronous.
sentences.zh: 一个明显的用例是自定义确认对话框，它需要异步。

sentences.en: View transitions likely need to be asynchronous as well, so a plugin could delay a swap until the transition is done.
sentences.zh: 视图转换可能也需要异步，因此插件可以延迟交换，直到转换完成。

sentences.en: I’m sure there’s more things that I’m missing.
sentences.zh: 我确信我还缺少更多的东西。

blocks.html_en: Those are left as exercises for the reader. Or you can just use htmx?

sentences.en: Those are left as exercises for the reader.
sentences.zh: 这些留给读者作为练习。

sentences.en: Or you can just use htmx?
sentences.zh: 或者你可以只使用htmx？

content_html_zh:
这是关于构建流行 Web 框架的小型“克隆”的一系列文章的延续。

Web 正在迅速变化，我们用来构建 Web 应用程序的工具也随之变化（不过，我很高兴我的 React/Vue 帖子现在已经有七年历史了，而且这些框架仍然很流行且相关）。

今天的热门话题是 htmx，它基本上是一个为不关心 JavaScript 的后端开发人员提供的前端库。 HTMX 最初是作为中冷器，然后演变和发展了更多功能，它有一些美丽之处：

<button hx-post="/clicked"
    hx-trigger="click"
    hx-target="#parent-div"
    hx-swap="outerHTML">
    Click Me!
</button>

它以声明的方式表示：当单击按钮时，向 /clicked 发送 POST 请求，并将 id #parent-div 的元素的外部 HTML 替换为响应数据。 HTMX 将事件、AJAX 请求和 DOM 更新连接在一起，隐藏了前端的复杂性。 只要您的后端可以发送 HTML 模板，您就可以使用它并构建完整的应用程序，而无需一行 JavaScript。

方法、触发器、目标、交换

看看上面的例子，我们的库似乎应该基于一些触发器来 fetch() 一些 URL，并更新（交换）一些目标元素的内容。 像这样的东西：

<button x-get="/click">Click me</button>

document.querySelectorAll('[x-get]').forEach(el => {
    el.addEventListener('click', async (e) => {
        e.preventDefault();
        const url = el.getAttribute('x-get');
        const response = await fetch(url);
        const data = await response.text();
        el.outerHTML = data;
        console.log(data);
    });
});

如果我们的后端发送“单击按钮”作为响应 - 它应该可以工作。 打开一个页面，单击按钮，按钮消失，改为显示文本。 这就是 10 行代码的 HTMX。

这里有一些需要改进的地方。 首先，最好清理响应以确保它是 HTML。 其次，我们应该允许用户指定要交换内容的目标元素。 第三，我们应该允许用户指定如何准确地交换目标中的内容：替换、追加、前置、删除元素等：

const attr = (el, name) => el.closest(`[${name}]`)?.getAttribute(name);

const SWAP = {
  outerHTML: (t, f) => t.replaceWith(f),
  beforebegin: (t, f) => t.before(f),
  afterbegin: (t, f) => t.prepend(f),
  beforeend: (t, f) => t.append(f),
  afterend: (t, f) => t.after(f),
  delete: t => t.remove(),
  none: () => {},
};

const swap = (mode, target, html) => {
  const tpl = document.createElement('template');
  tpl.innerHTML = html;
  (SWAP[mode] || ((t, f) => t.replaceChildren(f)))(target, tpl.content);
};

现在我们可以编写一个更通用的“fetcher”函数来处理不同的方法、触发器、目标和交换模式：

const send = async (el, method, url) => {
  const sel = attr(el, 'x-target');
  const target = sel ? document.querySelector(sel) : el;
  const mode = attr(el, 'x-swap') || 'innerHTML';
  const opts = { method: method.toUpperCase(), headers: { 'X-Request': 'true' } };
  if (el.matches('form')) opts.body = new URLSearchParams(new FormData(el));
  const res = await fetch(url, opts);
  swap(mode, target, await res.text());
};

默认情况下，我们更新元素的内容，除非指定了 x-target 或 x-swap。 我们还遵循 HTMX 约定，并将自定义标头与请求一起发送到后端。 为了将它们绑定在一起，我们添加一个简单的事件监听器，然后根据触发器分派请求：

const METHODS = ['get', 'post', 'put', 'patch', 'delete'];

const defaultTrigger = el =>
  el.matches('form') ? 'submit' : el.matches('input,select,textarea') ? 'change' : 'click';

const scan = (root = document.body) =>
  METHODS.forEach(m =>
    root.querySelectorAll(`[x-${m}]`).forEach(el => {
      if (el.$hx) return;
      el.$hx = true;
      const evt = attr(el, 'x-trigger') || defaultTrigger(el);
      el.addEventListener(evt, e => {
        e.preventDefault();
        send(el, m, el.getAttribute(`hx-${m}`));
      });
    })
  );

scan();
// we should also call scan() after each 
// swap() inside send() at the end of it

就这样，在 40 行代码中，我们得到了一个可工作的 HTMX 克隆，它支持所有 HTTP 方法、自定义目标和交换策略。 一个小的优化是避免在每次交换后重新扫描整个 DOM，而是只扫描新添加的内容：

new MutationObserver(ms => {
  for (const m of ms) m.addedNodes.forEach(n => { if (n.nodeType === 1) scan(n); });
}).observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });

现在它体积小而且性能好。

更好的触发器

我们可以为触发器引入自定义语法，允许以逗号分隔的事件列表，具有可选的延迟、“更改”或“一次”修饰符等：

const parseTriggers = (s) => {
  const triggers = s.split(',').map(s => s.trim());
  return triggers.map(trigger => {
    const [event, ...rest] = trigger.split(' ');
    const options = {};
    rest.forEach(opt => {
      const [key, value = true] = opt.split(':');
      options[key] = value;
    });
    return { event, options };
  });
}

这将返回带有选项的事件列表（键/值，在 HTML 属性中用冒号分隔）。 现在我们可以编写诸如 x-trigger="load, click one, changechangeddelay:500" 之类的内容。 我们还应该在 scan() 函数中处理一些事件，以特殊的方式处理它们，即 load 基本上是 setTimeout(() => send(...), 0)，changed 缓存以前的值，如果值保持不变则跳过 send，一旦在第一次触发后删除事件侦听器，delay 是具有指定延迟的另一个 setTimeout。 您的幻想是极限，我们可以像 HTMX 一样支持视口交互触发器、排队、去抖动、周期性事件等等。 但我们在这里构建了一个糟糕的 HTMX 克隆。

更好的目标

到目前为止，我们使用简单的 querySelector 来查找要将内容交换到哪个元素。 在实践中，我们可能希望支持更多修饰符，例如匹配最近的祖先或以下兄弟。

const resolve = (el, sel) => {
  if (!sel) return el;
  if (sel === 'this') return el;
  if (sel === 'next') return el.nextElementSibling;
  if (sel === 'previous') return el.previousElementSibling;
  if (sel === 'document') return document;
  if (sel === 'body') return document.body;
  if (sel === 'window') return window;
  if (sel.startsWith('closest ')) return el.closest(sel.slice(8));
  if (sel.startsWith('find ')) return el.querySelector(sel.slice(5));
  return document.querySelector(sel);
};

我们从 send() 而不是 document.querySelector(sel) 调用它，现在我们可以编写 x-target="closest .container" 或 x-target="next" 之类的内容来定位比全局查询定位的更具体的元素。 如果您想检查代码，HTMX 的作用实际上大致相同。

更好的活动

HTMX 发出像 htmx:beforeRequest 这样的自定义事件，允许开发人员拦截它们、修改和控制请求流。 我们也可以这样做。 我们总共发出 4 个事件：beforeRequest、afterRequest、beforeSwap、afterSwap。 每个事件都会在触发请求的元素上发出，并具有当前 send() 的完整上下文。 可以通过调用 event.preventDefault() 取消事件。

我们还尝试支持服务器端事件，例如 HX-Trigger 或 HX-Redirect。 如果服务器发送 HX-Trigger 标头，我们将使用该标头中的内容调度自定义事件。 如果服务器发送 HX-Redirect，我们只需将浏览器重定向到该 URL。 我在这里保留了 HX 前缀，因为 X-... headers 是标准 HTTP 标头的常见约定。

const send = async (el, method, url) => {
  let target = resolve(el, attr(el, "x-target"));
  let mode = attr(el, "x-swap") || "innerHTML";
  const opts = {
    method: method.toUpperCase(),
    headers: { "HX-Request": "true" },
  };
  if (el.matches("form")) opts.body = new URLSearchParams(new FormData(el));
  if (!fire(el, "x:beforeSend", { el, url, target, mode, opts }, true))
    return;
  const response = await fetch(url, opts);
  const hdrTrigger = response.headers.get("HX-Trigger");
  if (hdrTrigger) {
    try {
      const data = JSON.parse(hdrTrigger);
      Object.entries(data).forEach(([ev, d]) => fire(document.body, ev, d));
    } catch {
      fire(document.body, hdrTrigger);
    }
  }
  if (response.headers.get("HX-Redirect")) {
    window.location.href = response.headers.get("HX-Redirect");
    return;
  }
  if (response.headers.get("HX-Refresh") === "true") {
    window.location.reload();
    return;
  }
  if (response.headers.get("HX-Retarget"))
    target = resolve(el, response.headers.get("HX-Retarget"));
  if (response.headers.get("HX-Reswap"))
    mode = response.headers.get("HX-Reswap");
  const html = await response.text();
  fire(el, "x:afterSend", { el, url, opts, target, mode, response, html });
  const detail = { el, url, target, mode, html, response };
  if (!fire(el, "x:beforeSwap", detail, true)) return;
  swap(detail.mode, detail.target, detail.html);
  fire(el, "x:afterSwap", detail);
  scan(detail.target); // rebind anything the swap just brought in
};

我们最终的 send() 变得更大，但它允许我们现在编写插件，但拦截请求和交换。 请注意我们如何将事件详细信息从一个事件传播到另一个事件，这意味着事件处理程序可以修改请求和交换流。 例如，插件可以拦截 x:beforeSwap 并根据某些条件或属性更改目标或交换模式。

插件

我对 HTMX 的最初印象是它只做一件事：如果事件发生在具有声明性配置的某个元素上 – 向某个 URL 发送 AJAX 请求并将响应交换到其他某个元素。 但如果你检查参考资料，你会看到 hx-on、hx-vals、hx-headers、hx-swap-oob、hx-params、hx-push-url、hx-history-elt、hx-sse、hx-ext 和更多属性，这些属性使其不太容易理解。

我们可以在不修改核心“循环”的情况下实现一些功能对等吗？ 所以我们图书馆的“本质”就是“SSS”：扫描+发送+交换。

例如，HTMX 支持“增强”——增强链接和表单以使用 AJAX 而不是整页重新加载（以避免在每个导航链接上编写 x-get 和 x-target）。 这甚至不必是一个插件，只是一个 JS 片段：

document.addEventListener('click', e => {
  const boosted = e.target.closest('[x-boost]');
  if (!boosted) return;
  const link = e.target.closest('a');
  if (!link) return;
  const href = link.getAttribute('href');
  if (!href || href.startsWith('#') || link.getAttribute('target')) return;
  e.preventDefault();
  window.x.send(boosted, 'get', href);
});

同样，我们可以在提交时“增强”表单。 还有更多可能的插件可以实现：

  • x-confirm — 在发送之前弹出本机确认（），允许用户取消它。 需要 x:beforeSend 监听器，e.preventDefault() 拒绝。
  • x-indicator — 在请求正在进行时显示旋转器。 需要 x:beforeSend 来切换类/样式，并需要 x:afterSwap 来撤消它。
  • x-disable — 在请求期间禁用该元素（避免重复提交）。 与指标相同的逻辑。
  • x-headers — 来自 JSON 属性的额外请求标头。 解析、合并到 x:beforeSend 中的 opts.headers 中。
  • x-vals / x-include — 在请求中注入额外的值。 需要在 x:beforeSend 中改变 opts.body。
  • x-select — 交换响应的片段而不是整个 HTML（使后端代码更简单）。 使用querySelector我们想要的部分，替换x:beforeSwap中的detail.html以使用该部分。
  • x-sync — 最多有一个正在运行的请求：中止旧请求、使用新请求或将其排队。 由目标键入的地图。
  • x-validate — 在发送之前运行浏览器本机约束验证。 一切都在 x:beforeSend 中完成。
  • x-push-url / x-replace-url — 从属性或 HX-Push-Url/HX-Replace-Url 标头更新浏览器历史记录。 需要 x:afterSwap 中的history.pushState/replaceState。
  • x-sse / x-ws — 使用流消息作为响应并交换其内容。 这里根本没有请求/响应循环，只需从 onmessage 调用 x.swap() 即可。

这些都不需要对核心 x.js 进行任何更改，每个插件都是十几行代码，易于推理和调试。 看起来基于事件的插件架构和“SSS”API 的工作效果比我希望的要好（而且它仍然比 htmx 小）。

然而，为了使其与 HTMX 完全兼容，核心需要一些额外的工作。 我们需要对失败的 fetch()、非 2XX 响应等进行适当的错误处理。这可能需要触发更多自定义事件。 我们还可能需要将resolve()暴露给插件，以便它们可以在任何地方使用相同的x-target语法。 我们还需要一些基于承诺的取消。 一个明显的用例是自定义确认对话框，它需要异步。 视图转换可能也需要异步，因此插件可以延迟交换，直到转换完成。 我确信我还缺少更多的东西。

这些留给读者作为练习。 或者你可以只使用htmx？
